text:
Maya: Heads-up — anyone up for a last-minute roadtrip tomorrow? thinking coast, 2-3 hr drive, open to surf or a chill hike. leaving early or late morning?
Jordan: I'm in if we can leave by 7am :coffee: early start but worth it. can bring coffee + thermos.
Priya: Tempting — I might need to be back by evening for babysitter, so afternoon option works better for me.
Samir: If there's surf count me in. Also can we carpool? I have space for 2 people + boards.
Maya: @Samir awesome — I can drive and fit a board on top. 4 seats incl me.
Jordan: @Priya fair — we could do a hybrid: leave early for the core crew, meetup with the afternoon crew at the beach around 11:30.
Priya: That sounds good. also, who's on snack duty? I will bring fruit + something vegan.
Samir: I'll handle the playlist and a small speaker. dropping link: https://example.com/playlist/roadtrip-vibes
Maya: Weather looks breezy but sunny, bring a windbreaker + towel. tide is lowish in the morning which is good for exploring tidepools.
Jordan: I can bring bagels (not sourdough heroic bake this time) and disposable cups. :bagel: :thumbsup:
Priya: Vote quick: surf / hike / beach-picnic — what's everyone pref?
Samir: surf > picnic > hike for me.
Jordan: picnic > surf > hike (depends on waves).
Maya: picnic > hike > surf (I need to give my knees a break).
Priya: picnic > hike > surf (I'm team picnic).
DevBot: calendar invite created: "Redwood Last-Minute Coast Trip" — Sun 2026-03-29 07:00 PST — attendees: Maya, Jordan, Samir, Priya — https://calendar.example/evt/12345
Maya: Nice — I'll add a short checklist in the thread: sunscreen, water, layers, first-aid kit, trash bag.
Jordan: Also could use a hand carrying coolers — I have a collapsible one if someone can lift it into the trunk.
Samir: I'll help with loading. see you all bright and early. :sunglasses:
Priya: If anything changes ping the channel or DM me. otherwise I'm in for the meetup at 11:30. :raised_hands:
Maya: Awesome crew — see y'all! :wave:
